seed: The first guide of the Components track: something you drew becomes something you can fetch. It brings a button drawn as two loose layers on clear page, and walks the order that actually stops people: pick both, group them, and only then make a component. Make Component is dead until the pieces are one group, so a person who reaches for it on two selected shapes finds a row that does nothing and no reason why.

steps.note: the guide opened a page of its own with one button on it, drawn as a box and a label and nothing else, so a selection box dragged round it catches both and catches nothing else
a real selection box round both layers moved it on
Command G really is the Group row, and the two layers are one group
THE TEST: nothing on the page moved, the group wears four violet diamonds, the shelf opened itself on Components, and the Name box is waiting with the name selected
typing straight after the command named it, and the last step rings the shelf where the tile now sits beside the ones the app came with
